articles.title: Guardian readers fund life-changing surgery for Somali boy injured in US airstrike
articles.description:
After Guardian investigation uncovered drone strike that killed 12 civilians and injured many more, seven-year-old Abdiqadir Salah underwent vital operation in Mogadishu
On the rickshaw ride to the hospital, Marian Haji Abdi Guled felt a mixture of joy and apprehension: the day they had been waiting for had finally arrived.
Almost a year earlier, her then seven-year-old son, Abdiqadir Salah, had been seriously injured, alongside his two siblings, in what a Guardian investigation found was a US drone strike on the village of Jamaame in Somalia that killed at least 12 civilians, including eight children.

articles.title: Skull fractures suggest servants of Egypt’s ancient kings were sacrificed
articles.description:
Study of remains taken from royal cemetery at Umm el-Qa’ab appears to confirm early Egyptologist’s theory
Court officials and craftspeople serving early Egyptian kings may have been sacrificed when their ruler died, according to research that found fractures in several ancient skulls.
The royal cemetery of Umm el-Qa’ab near Abydos features the tombs and enclosures of the First Dynasty rulers of Egypt, and dates as far back as 3,000BC.
 Continue reading...

articles.title: Egyptian journalist faces terrorism charges after entire newsroom detained
articles.description:
Calls for release of six Matsadaash staff after one is charged, while whereabouts of other five remain unknown
An Egyptian journalist has been charged with joining a terrorist group, days after an entire newsroom was detained in what rights groups have said is a crackdown on press freedoms.
Last week, authorities arrested six journalists from the independent fact-checking and investigative platform Matsadaash – literally meaning “don’t believe” – accusing them in a statement of being unlicensed and publishing false news on behalf of the outlawed Muslim Brotherhood.
 Continue reading...

articles.title: Libyan unity talks upended as warlord’s son linked to drone attacks on fuel facilities
articles.description:

Allegations that the son of the Libyan warlord Khalifa Haftar oversaw a “terror cell” that launched drone attacks on fuel storage facilities and power stations in western Libya have upended plans for the Tripoli-based government of national unity (GNU) to continue cooperating with Haftar on a plan to unify the country.
Saddam Haftar, the deputy commander of the so-called Libyan National Army (LNA), has increasingly been seen by the US as an important figure in its plans to unify Libyan security, judicial and political institutions.

articles.description:
Artwork created in Tahrir Square for Chinese president’s state visit to Egypt is painted over amid allegations it revived Afrocentric claims about pharaohs’ origins
On the eve of the Chinese president Xi Jinping’s state visit to Cairo last month, the city authorities were busy removing a 66-metre-long mural from the esteemed guest’s line of sight.
Depicting the Pharaoh Tutankhamun and Queen Nefertiti, the painting was among 40 murals commissioned to beautify the city for Xi’s arrival and was painted by a group of young volunteers, Rasmet Basma, in Tahrir Square.
 Continue reading...

articles.description:
Experts say strength of evangelical church and perception that Lula is too old also helped propel Jair Bolsonaro’s son to first-round election win
On Sunday night, as the scale of the far-right triumph in Brazil sank in, an adapted football chant rang out in one of Rio’s most leftwing areas.
“Let’s turn this around, Lu-laaaaa! Let’s turn this around, Lu-laaaaa! Let’s turn this around, Lu-laaaaa!” crestfallen progressives bellowed while drowning their sorrows after witnessing a excruciating election setback for their leader, Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva.

articles.title: Flávio Bolsonaro poised to win Brazilian presidency after shock first-round victory
articles.description:
Progressive voters and supporters of incumbent president Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva left reeling after far-right surge
Flávio Bolsonaro is in pole position to win Brazil’s presidential election, after a far-right tsunami propelled him to a shock first-round victory over the incumbent, Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva, leaving progressive voters reeling.
The 45-year-old rightwing candidate received 56.1m votes to Lula’s 53.8m – 47.03% to 45.16% – meaning the 80-year-old leftwinger has a mountain to climb if he is to bounce back in the second round on 25 October. Never, since the return of democracy to Brazil in 1985, has the first-round runner-up managed to turn the game around and win the second ballot.
 Continue reading...

Parti Québécois promises to hold independence referendum in Canada’s French-speaking region by 2028
Voters in Quebec are going to the polls in provincial elections which will probably result in victory for a party that has promised to hold a referendum on independence from Canada within the next two years.
If polls are correct, the Parti Québécois (PQ) will form the government of the province of roughly nine million, the first time that the separatist movement will have gained power in the French-speaking region for more than a decade.

articles.summary: フランスで約2週間前に始まった学校での抗議運動が広がり、若者による街頭デモが政府に懸念を与えている。

articles.title: Putin warns West that Russia is ready to use every weapon to protect Kaliningrad
articles.description: The Russian leader insists Moscow is "not threatening anyone" and is merely responding to statements by Western leaders.
articles.titleJa: プーチン大統領、カリーニングラード保護のためあらゆる兵器の使用も辞さないと西側を警告
articles.summary: プーチン大統領は、カリーニングラード保護のためあらゆる兵器の使用も辞さないと西側を警告。西側指導者の声明への対応であり、脅迫ではないと主張した。

articles.title: Spain and China are cosying up - to the anger of many in the EU
articles.description: Amid global tumult, the two countries' alliance is not the only unlikely pairing.
articles.titleJa: スペインと中国が接近、EU内で怒りの声
articles.summary: 世界的な混乱の中、スペインと中国が接近し、EU内で多くの怒りを買っている。この異例の連携は、国際関係における唯一の不釣り合いな組み合わせではない。

articles.title: Seoul warns 'further action' if Ukraine does not apologise over prisoner-of-war row
articles.description: President Lee Jae Myung also accused Kyiv of "attempting to provoke a war on the Korean Peninsula".
articles.titleJa: 捕虜問題でウクライナが謝罪しなければ「さらなる行動」とソウルが警告
articles.summary: 韓国は捕虜問題を巡り、ウクライナが謝罪しない場合「さらなる行動」を取ると警告。キエフが朝鮮半島での戦争を誘発しようとしていると非難した。

articles.title: Spanish PM Sánchez loses key housing crisis vote after eviction of woman, 87
articles.description: The defeat raises pressure on Sánchez to call a snap election, after a series of scandals affecting his party and allies.
articles.titleJa: スペインのサンチェス首相、87歳女性立ち退き後、住宅危機に関する重要採決で敗北
articles.summary: スペインのサンチェス首相が、87歳女性の立ち退きを巡る住宅危機関連の重要採決で敗北。この敗北は、首相が早期総選挙を呼びかける圧力につながっている。

articles.title: Russian dissident Garry Kasparov says US warned him of danger to his life
articles.description: "My family and I will not truly be safe as long as Putin is in power," says the former chess world champion.
articles.titleJa: ロシアの反体制派ガルリ・カスパロフ、米国から命の危険を警告されたと語る
articles.summary: ロシアの反体制派ガルリ・カスパロフ氏が、米国から自身の命に危険が及ぶ可能性があると警告されたと明かした。「プーチンが権力を握っている限り安全ではない」と語る。

articles.title: Swiss glaciers suffer 'disastrous' year of ice loss, threatening water supplies
articles.description: Scientists say such rapid melting is no longer surprising given the pace of climate change.
articles.titleJa: スイスの氷河が「壊滅的な」年間氷消失に見舞われ、水供給を脅かす
articles.summary: スイスの氷河が壊滅的な規模で氷を失い、水供給を脅かしている。気候変動のペースを考えると、この急速な融解は驚くべきことではないと科学者らは述べる。

articles.title: What to know about Brazil's election as Lula and Flávio Bolsonaro face off
articles.description: Polls suggest the election will be a closely run contest between the left-wing incumbent and his right-wing rival.
articles.titleJa: ブラジル大統領選挙について知っておくべきこと：ルーラとフラビオ・ボルソナロが対決
articles.summary: 世論調査では、左派の現職ルーラと右派のライバル、フラビオ・ボルソナロによるブラジル大統領選挙は接戦が予想されている。

articles.title: The wealthy Cuban Americans ready and waiting for Havana to fall
articles.description: Cuban exiles in Florida are increasingly hopeful that regime change in Cuba is now on the horizon.
articles.titleJa: ハバナ陥落を待ち望む裕福なキューバ系アメリカ人たち
articles.summary: フロリダに住むキューバ系亡命者たちは、キューバでの政権交代が間近に迫っているとますます期待を寄せている。

articles.title: More than 5,000 people killed or injured in Haiti due to gang violence this year, UN says
articles.description: The United Nations said violent gangs continue to "adapt and expand" across the country, further threatening its stability.
articles.titleJa: 国連、ハイチで今年ギャングの暴力により5,000人以上が死傷と発表
articles.summary: 国連は、ハイチで今年ギャングの暴力により5,000人以上が死傷したと発表。ギャングが勢力を拡大し、国の安定を脅かしている。

articles.title: Venezuelan man shot by ICE in Texas is charged with assault
articles.description: Wilber Rafael Garces-Perez is accused of striking an agent with his car's side-view mirror while driving away.
articles.titleJa: テキサス州でICEに撃たれたベネズエラ人男性が暴行罪で起訴
articles.summary: ウィルバー・ラファエル・ガルセス＝ペレス氏が、テキサス州でICE捜査官を車のサイドミラーで打ったとして暴行罪で起訴された。

articles.title: Mexico's National Guard debuts chihuahua dog recruit named 'Comando'
articles.description: The 13-month-old small canine is equipped with protective gear and a camera, and is being trained for search-and-rescue missions.
articles.titleJa: メキシコ国家警備隊、チワワ犬の新兵「コマンド」を初披露
articles.summary: メキシコ国家警備隊が、保護具とカメラを装着し捜索救助任務の訓練を受ける13ヶ月のチワワ犬「コマンド」を公開した。

articles.title: Hurricane Polo makes landfall on Mexico's Pacific coast
articles.description: The storm moved ashore on the Baja California peninsula, which is a popular tourist destination.
articles.titleJa: ハリケーン「ポロ」、メキシコ太平洋岸に上陸
articles.summary: ハリケーン「ポロ」が人気の観光地であるバハ・カリフォルニア半島に上陸。地域に影響を与えている。

articles.title: Venezuela releases dozens of political prisoners as election calls grow
articles.description: A slew of dissidents being released from long-term detention comes days after the nation's interim leader met the US president.
articles.titleJa: ベネズエラ、選挙要請の高まりを受け数十人の政治犯を釈放
articles.summary: ベネズエラは、暫定指導者が米国大統領と会談した数日後、長期間拘留されていた数十人の反体制派を釈放した。

articles.title: New wild cat species discovered - with only one known living member
articles.description: A spotted wildcat long mistaken for relatives has been identified as a new species in Bolivia.
articles.titleJa: 新しいヤマネコ種が発見される — 既知の生き残りは一匹のみ
articles.summary: 長らく近縁種と誤認されてきた斑点のあるヤマネコが、ボリビアで新種として特定された。既知の生き残りは一匹のみである。

articles.title: 'He was a lifeline' - Families at a loss after Haitian caregivers let go in US
articles.description: Haitian immigrants make up a large portion of the already overburdened home-care workforce.
articles.titleJa: 「彼は命綱だった」－ハイチ人介護者が米国で解雇され、家族が途方に暮れる
articles.summary: 米国でハイチ人介護者が解雇され、彼らに頼っていた家族が途方に暮れている。ハイチ人移民は、在宅介護労働力の多くを占める。

articles.title: Trump's response is key as Argentina's Falklands demands get louder
articles.description: With Argentina's President Milei promising "winds of change" over the Falklands, will Donald Trump shift his stance on British rule?
articles.titleJa: アルゼンチンのフォークランド諸島要求が高まる中、トランプ氏の反応が鍵に
articles.summary: アルゼンチンのミレイ大統領がフォークランド諸島（マルビナス諸島）に関する「変化の風」を約束する中、トランプ氏の英国統治への姿勢が注目される。

articles.title: In Brazil’s capital, residents grow their own heat-fighting solutions
articles.description: Life in the favelas surrounding Brazil’s capital brings the health risks of extreme heat — a symptom of the global inequities of green space access
articles.titleJa: ブラジルの首都で、住民たちは熱対策として独自の解決策を育む
articles.summary: ブラジルの首都のファベーラ住民は、猛暑による健康リスクに直面。緑地へのアクセスにおける世界的な不平等を背景に、住民は独自の熱対策を実践している。

articles.title: Equating protest with terrorism: A narrative against dissent
articles.description: In this month's edition, we dive deep into a narrative used by leaders in the United States and other countries to delegitimize protests.
articles.titleJa: 抗議活動をテロリズムと同一視する：反対意見を抑圧する物語
articles.summary: 米国などの指導者によって、抗議活動をテロリズムと同一視することで異議申し立てを正当性を奪う物語が深掘りされる。表現の自由に対する懸念が高まっている。

articles.title: The commodification of Indigenous cultures and traditions
articles.description: Too often, resources and meaning flow outward from the community that created them and enrich outsiders — often the same groups that have been oppressing them for centuries.
articles.titleJa: 先住民文化と伝統の商品化
articles.summary: 先住民コミュニティが創造した文化や伝統が商品化され、その資源や意味が外部に流れ、しばしば長年彼らを抑圧してきた外部の集団を豊かにしている現状を批判。

articles.title: Ecuador detains former minister José Serrano after U.S. deportation
articles.description: Deported from the United States, Ecuador’s former “superminister” now faces grave criminal investigations and political accusations in a justice system facing questions over due process.
articles.titleJa: エクアドル、米国からの強制送還後、元大臣ホセ・セラーノを拘束
articles.summary: 米国から強制送還されたエクアドルの元「スーパー大臣」が、適正手続きに疑問が呈される司法制度のもと、深刻な刑事捜査と政治的告発に直面している。

articles.title: The A’uwẽ-Xavante people's denunciation of megaprojects in Brazil
articles.description: An Indigenous-led campaign denounces the impacts of a mega railway project and demands respect for territory, self-determination, and the right to live and dream.
articles.titleJa: アウウェ・シャヴァンテ族、ブラジルのメガプロジェクトを非難
articles.summary: ブラジルの先住民アウウェ・シャヴァンテ族が、巨大鉄道プロジェクトの影響を非難し、領土、自己決定、生きる権利への尊重を求めるキャンペーンを展開。

articles.title: ‘Pay-by-the-day’ living in Pereira: The forgotten survivors of Colombia’s earthquake
articles.description: In Pereira, Colombia, earthquake survivors living in pay-by-the-day rooms now face homelessness, overcrowded shelters, illness, and a struggle to be counted.
articles.titleJa: ペレイラでの「日払い」生活：コロンビア地震の忘れられた生存者たち
articles.summary: コロンビアのペレイラで、地震の生存者たちが日払い部屋での生活からホームレス、過密シェルター、病気、そして公式に数えられない苦境に直面している。

articles.title: Venezuela’s earthquakes leave children facing trauma, displacement and food insecurity
articles.description: As families seek refuge, Venezuela’s youngest children grapple with fear, disrupted routines and the loss of basic nutritional security.
articles.titleJa: ベネズエラの地震、子供たちにトラウマ、避難、食料不安をもたらす
articles.summary: ベネズエラの地震により、避難する家族の中で幼い子供たちが恐怖、乱れた日常、基本的な栄養の喪失に苦しんでいる。

articles.title: Amid political and economic pressure, Brazil sees a rise in land conflicts and the murders of Indigenous people
articles.description: Growing cases of violence against Indigenous people are linked to an impasse on the framework of rights and pressure against land demarcation, says the organization that advocates for Indigenous rights
articles.titleJa: 政治的・経済的圧力の中、ブラジルで土地紛争と先住民殺害が増加
articles.summary: 政治的・経済的圧力と権利の枠組みの行き詰まりが原因で、ブラジルでは先住民に対する暴力と土地紛争が増加し、殺害事件も報告されている。

articles.title: ‘The Sigh of the Earth’: Fragments from communities overlooked after Venezuela’s earthquakes
articles.description: Combining documentary photography, personal testimony, and digital intervention, the project preserves the quieter aftermath of Venezuela’s underreported communities after the earthquakes.
articles.titleJa: 「地球のため息」：ベネズエラ地震後、見過ごされたコミュニティからの断片
articles.summary: ベネズエラ地震後、あまり報じられないコミュニティの静かな余波を、ドキュメンタリー写真、個人的証言、デジタル介入を組み合わせて保存するプロジェクト。

articles.title: More than a month after Venezuela’s earthquakes: ‘I’m not leaving here until my son is found’
articles.description: One month after the two earthquakes, thousands of relatives remain beside the collapsed buildings in La Guaira despite harsh conditions and insufficient support for search efforts.
articles.titleJa: ベネズエラの地震から1ヶ月以上：「息子が見つかるまでここを離れない」
articles.summary: ベネズエラで発生した地震から1ヶ月以上が経過し、ラ・グアイラでは厳しい状況と支援不足にもかかわらず、数千人の親族が倒壊した建物のそばに留まり、行方不明の家族を探している。

articles.title: Supporters of jailed ex-PM Imran Khan begin march in Pakistan
articles.description: Thousands have taken to the streets after talks between authorities and Khan's party ended in deadlock.
articles.titleJa: 投獄された元首相イムラン・カーン氏の支持者がパキスタンでデモ行進を開始
articles.summary: パキスタンで、収監中の元首相イムラン・カーン氏の支持者が街頭デモを開始。当局とカーン氏の党との交渉が決裂したことを受け、数千人が参加している。

articles.title: Forced to call him 'Dad': Trial over sexual abuse in disabled care home shocks South Korea
articles.description: The BBC spoke to one of three residents at a care home who were sexually assaulted by a staff member.
articles.titleJa: 「パパと呼ぶことを強制」：障がい者介護施設での性的虐待裁判が韓国に衝撃
articles.summary: 韓国の障がい者介護施設で、職員による入居者への性的虐待が発覚。被害者の一人がBBCに語り、裁判が韓国社会に大きな衝撃を与えている。

articles.title: Indian police accused of sexually harassing journalists at protest
articles.description: The allegations were made after police detained dozens of protesters demanding the resignation of the election chief over changes to voter rolls.
articles.titleJa: インド警察、抗議デモでジャーナリストに性的嫌がらせの疑い
articles.summary: インドで、有権者名簿変更を巡る選挙管理委員長辞任要求デモ中に、警察がジャーナリストに性的嫌がらせをしたとの疑惑が浮上。警察は数十人のデモ参加者を拘束した。

articles.title: India's 'cockroach' protesters are back - this time asking poll chief to resign
articles.description: Thousands of people have turned up at a protest in Mumbai called by the Cockroach Janta Party.
articles.titleJa: インドの「ゴキブリ」デモ隊が再び登場 — 今度は選挙管理委員長の辞任を要求
articles.summary: ムンバイで「ゴキブリ・ジャンタ党」が呼びかけた抗議デモに数千人が参加。有権者名簿変更を巡り、選挙管理委員長の辞任を求めている。

articles.title: Japan's first mayor to take maternity leave lands on TIME100 Next list
articles.description: Shoko Kawata's maternity leave drew mixed reactions in Japan, a country struggling to lift birth rates.
articles.titleJa: 日本で初めて育児休暇を取得した女性市長、TIME100次世代リーダーに選出
articles.summary: 日本初の育児休暇取得市長、川田晶子氏がTIME100 Nextリストに選ばれた。少子化に悩む日本で、彼女の育児休暇は賛否両論を呼んだ。

articles.title: Japan raises permanent residency fee by 20 times
articles.description: The hikes are part of immigration policy changes introduced to manage Japan's growing foreign population.
articles.titleJa: 日本、永住権手数料を20倍に引き上げ
articles.summary: 日本政府が永住権申請手数料を20倍に大幅引き上げ。これは、増加する在留外国人を管理するための入国管理政策変更の一環である。

articles.title: China funding UK research and sending it to Beijing's spies, MI5 warns
articles.description: British universities are being urged to sever ties with China General Technology Research Institute which is linked to the Chinese Ministry of State Security (MSS).
articles.titleJa: 中国、英国の研究に資金提供し北京のスパイに送付、MI5が警告
articles.summary: MI5が、中国が英国の研究に資金提供し、その成果を中国のスパイ組織に送っていると警告。英国の大学に対し、中国関連機関との関係を断つよう求めている。

articles.title: Inside India's forest villages, where a dangerous mix of crises led to 32 child deaths
articles.description: At least 32 children have died in India's Balaghat district since May amid outbreaks of measles and malaria.
articles.titleJa: インドの森林村で、複数の危機が重なり32人の子どもが死亡
articles.summary: インドのバラガート地区にある森林村で、麻疹とマラリアの流行により5月以降少なくとも32人の子どもが死亡。複数の危機が重なり悲劇が起きた。

articles.title: Pakistan launches deadly air strikes on Afghanistan
articles.description: The Afghan Taliban says nine civilians have died while Pakistan says the strikes killed 22 militants.
articles.titleJa: パキスタン、アフガニスタンに致命的な空爆を実施
articles.summary: パキスタンがアフガニスタンに対し空爆を実施。アフガンのタリバンは民間人9人が死亡と主張し、パキスタンは武装勢力22人を殺害したとしている。

articles.title: The vanishing world of India's street magicians
articles.description: India's street performers are struggling to survive as audiences shrink and public spaces become harder to access.
articles.titleJa: インドのストリートマジシャンたちの消えゆく世界
articles.summary: インドのストリートパフォーマーたちは、観客の減少と公共スペースへのアクセス困難により、生き残りに苦闘している。彼らの伝統的な世界が消えつつある。

articles.title: WTO MSME Group explores IP's role in trade, hears success stories and updates
articles.description: The Informal Working Group on Micro, Small and Medium-sized Enterprises (MSMEs) met on 2 October, with a focus on the practical role of intellectual property (IP) in helping small businesses innovate, grow and reach international markets. The meeting included an information session on IP tools and thematic presentations from members, international organizations and stakeholders. Several members reported on MSME initiatives in formal WTO committees.
articles.titleJa: WTO MSMEグループ、貿易におけるIPの役割を探求、成功事例と最新情報を聴取
articles.summary: WTOのMSME作業部会が開催。知的財産が中小企業の革新、成長、国際市場進出に果たす役割を議論し、成功事例を共有した。

articles.title: Co-sponsors of Plastics Dialogue hold first round of technical discussions following MC14
articles.description: At a meeting on 1 October 2026, WTO members participating in the Dialogue on Plastics Pollution and Environmentally Sustainable Plastics Trade (DPP) held the first substantive round of discussions across four areas of work: circular solutions to plastics pollution; waste-management technologies; single-use plastics; and trade-related plastics measures. Building on the DPP's outcomes from the 14th Ministerial Conference (MC14) in March 2026 and earlier technical work, the discussions were aimed at moving towards more focused and practical work in the lead-up to MC15.
articles.titleJa: プラスチック対話共同提案国、MC14後初の技術協議を実施
articles.summary: WTOプラスチック対話がMC14後初の技術協議を実施。プラスチック汚染対策、廃棄物管理、使い捨てプラスチック、貿易関連措置の4分野で議論を深化させた。

articles.title: Director-General cites concerns with pace of negotiations as chairs report on state of play
articles.description: A meeting of the Trade Negotiations Committee (TNC) on 1 October provided WTO members with an opportunity to take stock of the WTO's negotiating agenda six months after the 14th Ministerial Conference (MC14) in Yaoundé and voice their views on how to advance their work. Members heard readouts from the chairs of the negotiating bodies about the state of play in their respective talks.
articles.titleJa: 事務局長、交渉ペースに懸念を表明、議長らが現状を報告
articles.summary: 貿易交渉委員会会議でWTO事務局長が交渉ペースに懸念を表明。MC14から半年後の現状評価と、今後の進め方に関するメンバーの意見交換が行われた。

articles.title: Members take stock of latest discussions on WTO reform
articles.description: At a transparency session on 30 September, facilitators for the discussions on WTO reform reported on recent meetings among members on the four tracks of reform: foundational issues, decision- making, development and level playing field. The facilitators noted a high level of engagement with members' written and oral proposals submitted in recent weeks. They acknowledged that momentum is building across all four tracks, but substantial work remains.
articles.titleJa: メンバー、WTO改革に関する最新協議の現状を把握
articles.summary: WTO改革に関する協議で、基礎的課題、意思決定、開発、公平な競争条件の4分野の進捗が報告された。高い関与があるが、大幅な作業が未だ残されている。

articles.title: John H. Jackson Moot Court Competition kicks off with webinar support on offer
articles.description: Prospective participants in the 25th edition of the John H. Jackson Moot Court Competition on WTO Law, launched on 16 September 2026, are invited to attend webinars aimed at helping them to effectively participate in the competition.
articles.titleJa: ジョン・H・ジャクソン模擬裁判大会、ウェビナーサポート付きで開幕
articles.summary: 第25回ジョン・H・ジャクソンWTO法模擬裁判大会が開始。参加者向けに効果的な準備を支援するウェビナーが提供され、国際法への理解を深める機会となる。

articles.title: WTO members deepen discussions on trade and climate measures, share updates
articles.description: The Committee on Trade and Environment (CTE) met on 28-29 September to advance its discussions on the trade and environment nexus, focusing on interoperability and development aspects of trade-related climate measures. Members also built on the voluntary information sharing exercise launched earlier this year with a view to enhancing transparency of trade and climate measures in the Committee. In addition, they were briefed on work undertaken in other international fora and on developments in several member-led environmental initiatives at the WTO.
articles.titleJa: WTOメンバー、貿易と気候変動対策に関する議論を深化、最新情報を共有
articles.summary: 貿易と環境委員会が開催され、貿易と気候変動対策の関連性が深く議論された。相互運用性と開発側面が焦点で、情報共有を通じ、透明性向上を目指す。

articles.title: New Zealand advances safe and inclusive trade with new contribution to STDF
articles.description: New Zealand has contributed NZ$ 300,000 (approximately CHF 140,000) to the Standards and Trade Development Facility (STDF) to help developing and least-developed countries, including in the Pacific, strengthen food safety and animal and plant health systems.
articles.titleJa: ニュージーランド、STDFへの新たな拠出で安全で包括的な貿易を推進
articles.summary: ニュージーランドがSTDFに寄付し、途上国の食品安全や動植物衛生システム強化を支援。安全で包括的な貿易を促進する。

articles.title: WTO, Asian Development Bank and World Bank bring TS4D initiative to Asia and the Pacific
articles.description: The WTO, the Asian Development Bank and the World Bank Group jointly organized a regional conference in Manila on 28-29 September that brought for the first time the Trade in Services for Development (TS4D) initiative to the Asia-Pacific region. The event allowed trade officials and other stakeholders from the region to discuss the role of services trade in development, exchange views on the use of analytical tools developed under the initiative and share best practices and policy approaches for supporting services trade in the region.
articles.titleJa: WTO、アジア開発銀行、世界銀行が「開発のためのサービス貿易」イニシアチブをアジア太平洋地域へ
articles.summary: WTOなどがマニラで地域会議を開催し、「開発のためのサービス貿易」イニシアチブをアジア太平洋地域に導入。地域関係者が開発におけるサービス貿易の役割を議論した。

articles.title: Panel to review EU carbon border adjustment mechanism and emissions trading scheme
articles.description: The Dispute Settlement Body (DSB) agreed at its meeting on 25 September to a request from the Russian Federation for the establishment of a panel to review the European Union's Carbon Border Adjustment Mechanism (CBAM) Package and alleged export subsidy under the EU scheme for trading greenhouse gas emission allowances.
articles.titleJa: EU炭素国境調整メカニズムと排出量取引制度を審査するパネル設置へ
articles.summary: WTOの紛争解決機関（DSB）は、ロシア連邦の要請に基づき、EUの炭素国境調整メカニズム（CBAM）と排出量取引制度を審査するパネル設置に同意した。

articles.title: Members review farm policies in first meeting under new Chair
articles.description: At a meeting of the WTO Committee on Agriculture on 24-25 September, WTO members addressed matters raised regarding implementation of their commitments and members' specific notifications. They also discussed a counter-notification submitted by Australia on India's support policies for sugar and heard a briefing on the global state of farming from the UN Food and Agriculture Organization (FAO). This was the first meeting under the new Chair, Mr William Horgan of Ireland.
articles.titleJa: 新議長の下での初会合で、加盟国が農業政策を審査
articles.summary: WTO農業委員会で新議長の下、農政が審査された。インドの砂糖支援政策に関する異議申し立ても議論され、FAOが世界の農業状況を説明した。
